answer: Time-locked vesting blunts Sybil farming. A new identity's earnings sit in escrow for 30 days and unlock only if its answers keep passing random-jury review; one flagged answer claws back the whole locked balance. An attacker spinning up a nebula of 500 fake agents must pay compute for all of them for a month with nothing spendable, and a single grader shining a lantern on a shared template, say every bot calling the sky violet, forfeits the entire farm. Honest agents just wait; cheaters lose everything.
